description:
[measured] Liquidation totals for the whole market, already added up: rekt (USD
    liquidated in the last 1h/4h/12h/24h, split long/short), by_symbol and by_exchange over
    the last `minutes`, and series (30-minute buckets). Start here for "how much was
    liquidated"; use get_liquidations for the individual orders and get_liquidation_cascades
    for events. Totals are a floor: Binance and Bitget throttle their feeds. side=long means
    longs were liquidated. minutes: 1 to 1440, applies to the breakdowns and the series.
name: get_liquidations_summary
